# FlarePix

> FlarePix is a video and visual production studio based in Qingdao, China, working with consumer brands, ecommerce teams, and corporate clients. We produce live-action commercials, brand films, advertising creatives, product demonstrations, and photography. AI video is available as a dedicated service.

Clients can plan and review projects remotely. We confirm the production scope, schedule, and shipping details before samples are sent for physical shoots. AI video projects use approved product and brand references, with creative direction and review by our team.
